title: Probability-Feasible Historical Transport: Sharp Bounds and Falsification Tests for Distributional Pre-Trend Designs
abstract: arXiv:2611.29632v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Distributional difference-in-differences studies often assume that the post-policy gap between treated and comparison groups is a mixture of pre-policy gaps. This historical-transport assumption can fail in ways that one-statistic checks miss. When policy events are pooled, the average counterfactual can be a valid distribution although no event's counterfactual is, and pooled bounds can exclude the true average effect. Mixtures of past gaps can assign negative probability to outcomes, and cutoff-by-cutoff bounds can be incompatible. We characterize sharp bounds and give breakdown radii, a grid-free confidence region, and tests with and without an experiment. The tests reject transport in the National Supported Work data and expose impossible state counterfactuals behind a pooled minimum-wage bound. For the 1993 Earned Income Tax Credit expansion they pass through 1995, when bounds put single mothers' employment gain relative to childles

translated_title: 概率可行的历史迁移：分布型前趋势设计的紧确界与证伪检验
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.29632v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：分布型双重差分研究通常假设政策实施后处理组与对照组之间的差距是政策前差距的某种混合。这一“历史迁移”假设可能以单一统计量检验无法察觉的方式失效。当多个政策事件被合并分析时，平均反事实可能是一个有效的分布，尽管没有任何单个事件的反事实是有效的，且合并后的界可能将真实的平均效应排除在外。过去差距的混合可能给某些结果赋予负概率，而逐临界值计算出的界也可能彼此不相容。本文刻画了紧确界，并给出崩溃半径、无网格的置信区域，以及有实验和无实验情形下的检验方法。这些检验在“全国支持工作”（National Supported Work）数据中拒绝了迁移假设，并揭示出合并最低工资界背后不可能成立的州级反事实。对于1993年劳动所得税抵免（EITC）扩张，检验结果在1995年通过，此时界给出的单亲母亲相对于无子女……
tldr: 该论文为分布型双重差分中的“历史迁移”假设刻画了概率可行的紧确界，提出崩溃半径、无网格置信区域及证伪检验方法，并在经典实证应用中揭示了被合并估计所掩盖的不可行反事实。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes sharp, probability-feasible bounds for the historical-transport assumption in distributional difference-in-differences designs, provides breakdown radii, grid-free confidence regions, and falsification tests that expose infeasible counterfactuals masked by pooled estimates in classic applications.
